newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Dense fog delays flights at Sofia airport.
newsitem.headline: Dense fog delays flights at Sofia airport.

text.p: Dense fog delayed commercial aircraft from taking off and landing at Sofia airport on Friday morning and incoming flights were diverted to the Black Sea port of Bourgas, an airport official said.

"All outgoing flights were delayed this morning because of the fog and aircraft began taking off at 1000 local time (0800 GMT) hrs. We hope to start receiving incoming flights after 1300 local time (1100 GMT)," the official told Reuters. @

"Incoming flights from Bangkok and Johannesburg were diverted to (the Black Sea port of) Bourgas and outgoing fligths to Brussels, London, Frankfurt, Berlin and New York are expected to take off from Bourgas," said the official. -- Sofia Newsroom 359-2-84561
